screening.reason: Exclusion 3: ABIDE data used only for a structural-MRI (voxel-based morphometry grey-matter) sex-difference analysis; no resting-state functional analysis of ABIDE data is reported (the companion behavioural analysis uses NDAR, a separate non-ABIDE dataset).

evidence_quotes: We combined voxel-based morphometry (VBM) [38] with univariate and multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) [39] to determine GM regions that differ be- tween girls and boys with ASD.
